comment: Daily delinquency (brief 5.4): one row per credit facility x day in arrears (Apr-2023 to Sep-2026) with days past due, DPD bucket (1-29, 30-59, 60-89, 90+), overdue amount (USD and local currency), the arrears episode, its missed due date and cure date (a cure after 30-Sep-2026 is not known yet: null / not cured). Only days in arrears are present (a facility absent on a day is current). DPD and overdue amounts are point-in-time: never sum across days. For rates over the whole book (30+ DPD rate, cure rate) use fact_credit_exposure_monthly. Grain: one row per facility x day in arrears.
